name: @cartze/core
_note: The layer both apps stand on: design tokens, UI primitives, the HTTP
client, keychain prefs. Consumed by Metro/jest/tsc ALIAS rather than by
npm install — see mobile/metro.config.js. There is no build step and no
node_modules of its own: react and react-native resolve from whichever
app is doing the importing, because two copies of React in one bundle
